n.location: Methods, Participants (canonical form-feed page 6); Results, exclusions (pages 9-10)
n.quote:
The pre-registered sample of one hundred volunteers from Prolific ... were recruited for this study ... Nonword fillers were

excluded from the analyses. Incorrect responses were removed from the RT analysis (7.3% of

the data). Extreme outliers <200 ms and >2000 ms were removed (0.02% of the data). In ... addition, residual outlier trimming was applied (Baayen, 2008) which led to the removal of

2.4% of the data.

reported_success.quote:
In sum, the current study replicates Grainger et al.’s (2021) earlier findings, showing

that flanker effects in French are significantly greater for semantically transparent suffixed

words than for semantically opaque suffixed words or non-affixed words.
